The '''UR-6572-AK system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In it was located the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] self-aware [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The UR-6572-AK system was established in the [[2011]] novel [[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']], written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].
